scope: Publication copy of the completed build record; original observations retained under their recorded conditions
retained: checksummed Roundhouse and Spinel patch series
final, control and diagnostic gates, captured app evidence and binary identities
one-patch omission conditions: series, manifests, Dockerfiles, apply and recovery results
regression sources, bisect records, reductions and outcomes
upstream commit diffs, rejected rebase hunks and the final replay
normalization: Host checkout paths are repository-relative; the build record's own location is shown as this record's path.
$SCRATCH stands for the build's local working directory outside the record (emitted programs, bisect and toolchain contexts); it is not published.
Upstream author email addresses are redacted with the tools/scrub.py email rule; synthetic fixture addresses remain.
JSON HTTP routes use an equivalent slash escape; decoded values are unchanged.

Omission folders keep only the files that differ from the final record (series, SHA256SUMS, Dockerfiles, build and gate scripts) plus their apply and recovery results; byte-identical copies are omitted.

Seventeen bulky execution logs are omitted: eight bisect-candidate toolchain builds and nine probe logs whose rows equal retained results files. Each execution record keeps the log's size and SHA-256.

run.json describes the input series without its workspace path, keeps only the Docker lock, prefix and port constraints, and links this inventory; cleanup and retirement notes drop workspace wording and internal work-item labels.
The README states peak RSS in KiB as recorded. The MiB figures in the build notes (timing-vs-v9.json, run.json) are the KiB values divided by 1,000.
The README attributes the without-60 refusal to emission: in that build log roundhouse check exits 0 before roundhouse --target spinel refuses two controllers. The recorded finding text is unchanged.

The source variant, toolchain Dockerfiles, reproduction scripts and checksummed patches are byte-identical to the supplied record. The variant ledger, COMPILE-VARIANT.md, is the same file as in the v8 and v9 records.
excluded_results: Intermediate, interrupted, cancelled and cached-build attempts remain diagnostics, not final passing conditions.
